thread:
jess: FYI onboarding v3.2-int4 to canary now. Running staged shadow for 5% traffic. Need to lock down per-slice auto-fallback thresholds and A/B comparators. Thoughts?

sam: Which slices are we watching here? longdoc / codegen / short_answer / rerank? :thinking: 

ayana: Ran the eval sweep on the seeded slices this morning. Quick summary: codegen looks parity, short_answer slight uptick, longdoc shows MRR degradation. Full numbers below.

ayana: ```
slice: longdoc
baseline MRR: 0.721
v3.2-int4 MRR: 0.697
delta: -0.024 (-3.4%)

slice: codegen
baseline token-prec: 0.882
v3.2 token-prec: 0.881
delta: -0.1%

slice: short_answer
accept_rate: baseline 0.78 -> v3.2 0.782 (+0.2%)
```

jess: Thanks. For canary let's be conservative: per-slice delta thresholds and an overall weighted threshold. Proposal: longdoc fallback if delta <= -1.5% (i.e. -0.015), codegen <= -3%, short_answer <= -2%. Also fail fast on latency: P95 increase > 50ms triggers fallback.

max: Quick note — weight aggregated delta by production traffic share for each slice. Short_answer is ~60% traffic so it will dominate the overall metric if we don't weight.

jess: Agreed. Draft config I'm going to push to the canary rollout policy: 

jess: ```
fallback_policy:
  mode: slice_weighted
  thresholds:
    longdoc: -0.015
    codegen: -0.03
    short_answer: -0.02
  overall_threshold: -0.01
  latency_p95_ms: 50
  evaluation_window_minutes: 30
  min_requests: 2000
```

deploy-bot: smoke tests passed on canary nodes (canary-3/3). quick logs: https://logs.re/redwood/canary/1788200000 :white_check_mark:

ayana: One more thing — manual annotation on a 100-example longdoc sample shows hallucination rate increased: baseline 2/100 -> v3.2 6/100. That aligns with MRR drop; might be a model-side fidelity regression, not just tokenization/quant noise.

sam: Recommendation: auto-fallback if longdoc hallucination > 4% OR MRR delta <= -2.0%. Also open eval ticket for deeper root-cause. https://go/reports/issue/1234

jess: Good call. I'll update the rollout policy to include the hallucination sentinel and wire the human-review alert. Will monitor the first 2 hours and cut traffic if any threshold breaches. :eyes:

sam: Thanks — keep us posted.

ayana: ping me if you want the annotated examples. happy to hand off the eval pack.

jess: Will do. Tagging this thread for the oncall and the rollout dashboard.
